notes.title: Fix Shadow Options Not Working Error
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the shadow settings in the Options settings did not work

notes.title: New content and optional features
notes.content:
1. Added setting options for performance issues.
- You can set texture quality, shadows, etc.
2. Added 3D environment categories.
- Added about 30 new 3D environments.
3. Added new avatars.
- Added about 70 new avatars.
